analytics-unavailable: Demo eno tennaba na kwekenneenya kubaliddwa ku kitundu kino.
clips-planned: Okutambula mu demo n'obutundu bwa vidiyo bitegekeddwa.
error-invalid-demo: Londa fayiro ya CS2 .dem entuufu etali njereere.
error-network: Tekisoboka kutuuka ku mpeereza y'okwekenneenya. Kebera okuyungibwa kwo oddemu ogezeeko.
error-size-limit: Fayiro eno esukka ku kkomo ly'okuteekako ku seeva.
error-timeout: Demo etutte ekiseera ekiwanvu okukolebwako. Gezaako demo endala.
error-upload-timeout: Ekiseera ky'okuteekako kiwedde. Kebera okuyungibwa kwo oddemu ogezeeko.
evidence-disclaimer: Ebimanyiddwa mu muzannyo bujulizi, naye si kukakasa musango gwa bukodyo oba kigendererwa.
moment-entry: Okugezaako okuyingira kwaleka timu mu mbeera mbi nga tewali kutta eyasse munno mangu.
moment-flash: Bbomu etangaaza yayamba munne okutta omulabe.
moment-trade: Yatta omulabe eyasse munne n'azzaawo obwenkanyi bw'omuwendo gw'abazannyi.
moments-unavailable: Ebiseera ebikulu n'ensobi okusinziira ku mbeera tebinnabalibwa. Okufa okwawandiikibwa kwokka si bujulizi bwa nsobi.
offline: Toyungiddwa. Okuleeta ebipya kujja kuddamu ng'okuyungibwa kwo kukomyewo.
page-not-found-note: Enkolagana eno tetwala ku lipoota. Ddayo olonde omuzannyo.
refresh-failed: Tekisobose kuleeta bipya. Ebikwata ku muzannyo ebyasemba okuleetebwa bikyalagibwa.
site-description: Okwekenneenya emizannyo gya CS2. Weekenneenye abazannyi, lawundi n'obujulizi obuli emabega wa buli kyava mu muzannyo.
